name: schema-workflow-skippable-states
description: Schemas can now declare workflow steps as optional or disabled, with declarative checks (entry) and skipChecks (bypass) governed by monotonic allow* locks, so lightweight workflows can skip verification or implementation without hardcoded lifecycle assumptions. A core:workflow-topology service, a single-cascade binding resolver and the shared ResolveChangeSchema make lifecycle guidance, validity reconciliation, archive and skills follow the change's own schema; status, CLI and skills render and route from structured status instead of fixed sequences.
